## Pre processing

```{r}
data$target <- as.factor(data$target)
```

```{r}
# 표준화 함수
normalizer <- function(x) {
  return((x-mean(x))/sd(x))
}
```

```{r}
for(i in 1:45){
  if(i == 4) next
  data[,i] = normalizer(data[,i])
}
```

# SVM Linear

```{r, warning = FALSE}
n = nrow(data)
K = 10 # 10-fold CV

# 설정하려는 Seed 총 개수
Seed_Num = 10
  
# Seed, parameter 별로 일단 모두 저장
Accuracy_SVML <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FPR_SVML <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
FNR_SVML <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
F1_SVML <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

# Parameter grid 설정
cost_grid <- c(0.001,0.01,0.1,1,4)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  print("seed")
  print(seed)
  set.seed(seed)
  
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(cost in cost_grid){
      
      print("cost")
      print(cost)
      
      for(CV in 1:K){
        ########################################################################################
        # CV generation. Train : Test를 9:1로 나눔 (이때의 train, test는 validation approach)  #
        ########################################################################################
        print("CV")
        print(CV)
        
        CV_index <- split(sample(1:n), rep(1:K, length.out = n))
        train <- data[-CV_index[[CV]], ] # Train set
        train_index <- c(1:n) 
        train_index <- train_index[-CV_index[[CV]]] # Train set의 index (필요할 경우 사용)
        test <- data[CV_index[[CV]], ] # Test set
        test_rowNum <- nrow(test) # Test set row Numbers (필요할 경우 사용))
        
        #################################################################
        # Modeling and Prediction. Update Accuracy, FNR, FPR, F1 score  #
        #################################################################
        # Train 데이터셋이 필요한 경우
        Model <- svm(target ~ ., data = train, cost = cost, kernel = "linear")
        
        
        # Prediction (0, 1로 나오는 경우)
        pred <- predict(Model, newdata = test)
        
        # Update Scores
        Accuracy_SVML[[seed]] <- c(Accuracy_SVML[[seed]], mean(pred == test$target))
        FPR_SVML[[seed]] <- c(FPR_SVML[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 0)) / mean(test$target == 0))
        FNR_SVML[[seed]] <- c(FNR_SVML[[seed]], mean((pred != test$target) & (test$target == 1)) / mean(test$target == 1))
        F1_SVML[[seed]] <- c(F1_SVML[[seed]], 2*(mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))*mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))) / (mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(pred==1))+mean((pred==test$target)&(test$target==1))/(mean(test$target==1))))
      }
      
    
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Seed, parameter 별로 CV에 대해 평균내어 모두 저장
CVAccuracy_SVML <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFPR_SVML <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVFNR_SVML <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)
CVF1_SVML <- vector(mode = "list", length = Seed_Num)

for(seed in 1:Seed_Num){  # Seed를 다르게 하는 For loop
  # Parameter 별로 For loop
  for(param1 in 1:length(cost_grid)){
      CVAccuracy_SVML[[seed]] <- c(CVAccuracy_SVML[[seed]], mean(Accuracy_SVML[[seed]][1:K + K * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFPR_SVML[[seed]] <- c(CVFPR_SVML[[seed]], mean(FPR_SVML[[seed]][1:K + K * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVFNR_SVML[[seed]] <- c(CVFNR_SVML[[seed]], mean(FNR_SVML[[seed]][1:K + K * (param1 - 1)]))
      CVF1_SVML[[seed]] <- c(CVF1_SVML[[seed]], mean(F1_SVML[[seed]][1:K + K * (param1 - 1)]))
    
  }
}
```

## Accuracy

```{r}
SVML_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(CVAccuracy_SVML)
colnames(SVML_Accuracy) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
SVML_Accuracy <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(SVML_Accuracy)))

SVML_Accuracy
```

```{r}
SVML_Accuracy <- SVML_Accuracy%>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "Accuracy")%>%
  mutate(cost = cost_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)+1])%>%
  mutate(CV = (row_number()-1)%%K + 1)

SVML_Accuracy%>%
  filter(Accuracy > 0.6)%>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = Accuracy, y = Parameter), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_text(aes(x = Accuracy, y = Parameter, label = cost), stat = "summary", hjust = 3, size = 3)+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("SVM Linear", subtitle = "Accuracy")
```


## F1 score

```{r}
SVML_F1 <- as.data.frame(CVF1_SVML)
colnames(SVML_F1) <- c("CV1", "CV2", "CV3", "CV4", "CV5", "CV6", "CV7", "CV8", "CV9", "CV10")
SVML_F1 <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(SVML_F1)))

SVML_F1
```

```{r}
SVML_F1 <- SVML_F1%>%
  gather(key = "Parameter", value = "F1")%>%
  mutate(cost = cost_grid[((row_number()-1)%/%K)+1])%>%
  mutate(CV = (row_number()-1)%%K + 1)

SVML_F1%>%
  filter(F1 > 0.5)%>%
  ggplot()+
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = F1, y = Parameter), alpha = 0.2)+
  geom_text(aes(x = F1, y = Parameter, label = cost), stat = "summary", hjust = 3, size = 3)+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("SVM Linear", subtitle = "F1")
```
